description: 1 master suite (en-suite bathroom with bathtub), 1 single bedroom, 1 shower bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment, windows on two facades. Three separate wet rooms: en-suite bathroom with bathtub (11.9sqm) accessible only from master bedroom; shower bathroom (6.4sqm) from corridor; WC (2.5sqm) from corridor. Fully parallel morning routines possible for a household of three or more. Kitchen in open plan space, wall counter, no kitchen island. Cook faces wall. Living area with dining and seating zone. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. Bathroom config: 1 en-suite with bathtub; 1 shower-only bathroom; 1 WC. Master bedroom accessed via corridor with good acoustic separation. Single bedroom (9sqm) large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations: (1) children's bedroom; (2) home office or hobby room; (3) guest room; (4) bunk bed. Storage room in corridor zone, suitable for coats, bikes, laundry or utility storage. Entry from left. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits couples or small families where morning routine convenience is a priority.
not_suitable_for: households requiring two separate children's bedrooms and a home office simultaneously
